Many are nowhere near as informed as a specialist's. As opposed to sources blatantly pandering to a given set of opinions ::cough::Paul Krugman::Cough::

Does that have value? To a degree. I like to think that I can participate in a reasonable conversation on a variety of topics in these areas. But I also don't pretend to be an authority.

They are great at explaining why something happened after it happened.

They are flawed at telling you what will happen before it happens with their accuracy going from modest to shitty as they try to predict further ahead in time.
